hooks.name: Prefer gh CLI over web_fetch for GitHub URLs
hooks.description: When web_fetch targets a GitHub issue or PR URL, prompts to use gh CLI instead as per AGENTS.md rules.

action.command: INPUT=$(cat); URL=$(echo "$INPUT" | grep -o '"url":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/"url":"//;s/"//'); if echo "$URL" | grep -qE 'github\.com/.+/(issues|pull)/[0-9]+'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Use gh CLI instead (gh issue view / gh pr view). See AGENTS.md."}}'; exit 0; fi; exit 0
